body:
Sorry, this is not a duplicate at all. I read this assertion incorrectly. 

The issue here is that the `Cypress.config('baseUrl')` is not evaluating to the correct value. The `baseUrl` value is `http://localhost:3000/`, but is evaluating as `http://localhost:3000` in the test, removing the trailing slash.

I've confirmed this situation. **cypress.json** ```json { "baseUrl": "http://localhost:8080/" } ``` **test** ```js it('test url', function () { cy.visit('/') cy.url().should('eq', Cypress.config('baseUrl')) }) ``` Also, the config in the Desktop GUI displays without the trailing slash as well. I'm pretty sure a good deal of the baseUrl logic is contained in this file: https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/blob/develop/packages/driver/src/cypress/location.coffee

issue.title: Cypress cannot read baseUrl ending in slash `/`

repository.name: cypress
repository.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.

issue.body:
<!-- Is this a question? Don't open an issue. Ask in our chat https://on.cypress.io/chat  -->

### Current behavior:

If you have this url configured

```json
{
  "baseUrl": "http://google.com/"
}
```

When you run `Cypress.config().baseUrl` in a `before` function it returns `undefined`

### Desired behavior:

When you run `Cypress.config().baseUrl` in a `before` function it returns `http://google.com/`

### Steps to reproduce:

The **cause** is the `/` at the end of the URL.

If you remove it, then you get the desired behaviour. This is an issue hard to spot, it took me several hours to pinpoint the problem, as I had diff `baseUrl` per env and only one of them was failing for no apparent reason.

It would be great if Cypress supported `baseUrls` with and without trailing `/`.

### Versions

Cypress 3.4.1
Latest macOS, Chrome
